conflicts.resolution: The 2017-edition compliance manual remains a current WVHDF-linked source, but later dated official WVHDF procedures, forms, notices, and current program materials supersede conflicting manual language. The manual cannot override a later official source.

Current WVHDF resources link Certification Waiver Procedures effective 2019-01-01 and the LIHTC Annual Recertification Waiver Certification. Those later official materials supersede the older manual statement that no waiver would be issued.

The blank owner-certification form remains an official form, but an issuer-name anomaly inside the form cannot establish or alter governing rule authority. Authority remains WVHDF and controlling law; the form is retained as workflow evidence only.

The Allocation Plan warning that materials are subject to change is handled by effective-dated source versioning and monitoring. Current captured versions remain operative until an official superseding source is detected and validated.
The HOME/HTF handbook currency discrepancy remains blocked for HOME/HTF state-overlay activation but does not block the WV LIHTC-only pack.

The reported 2026-08-20 underwriting update is not treated as authority until it is observed on an official WVHDF source, captured, hashed, and evaluated for supersession. Its absence cannot silently change the current pack.
